review_notes:
The file has one theorem, `solution`, with a very long hypothesis list and a tactic proof. It declares no definitions, simp lemmas, simp attributes or simp sets, so it has no simp interface of its own to review. Its simp use is limited to three calls: `simpa [huWdef]` (twice), `simpa [Subalgebra.coe_algebraMap]` and a bare `simpa`. All three close small coercion goals, and I saw no sign of cycles, wrong orientation or competing rules in them.

The header runs a long `attribute [-simp] ...` list over many `ModularCurve.*` and `AlgebraicCurve.*` lemmas. These removals could point to unwanted expansion or competing rules in the library's simp set. I did not open the declarations, the other files or the proof to check whether that is true. Without that, I can't name a specific expression, a desired normal form or an exact orientation or attribute change, which the rubric requires. I therefore report no finding. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about how the simplifier behaves.
